card.title: How to fix iPhone 14 Error 9 with failed Rose

source.title: How to fix iPhone 14 Error 9 with failed Rose

claims.statement: iPhone 14 restores that fail with error 9 part-way, regardless of cable, computer or DFU, and whose restore logs show ROSE communication failure, need ROSE IC (U200_R) replacement.
The repair requires splitting the sandwich; excess force destroys interposer pads.

procedure: Confirm consistent error 9 and ROSE errors in restore logs.
Rule out cable, charge port and low battery.
Split the board with controlled preheat.
Replace ROSE IC U200_R; inspect joints.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Excessive force when splitting the sandwich can rip interposer pads.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
